status: Read-only reconciliation after the separately applied Road correction; All Expenses and report sources are not migrated.
methodology: Reconstructed signed expense records from live source values, selecting Setup actual before November 2026 and planned thereafter. Aggregated independently in memory without spreadsheet writes or temporary tabs. Tax stays in Cash Flow. Absolute comparison tolerance THB 0.01.

6.label: setup expenses
6.formula:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  IF(
    R_MONTHS < EOMONTH(TODAY(), -1) + 1,
    SETUP_ACTUAL_PARAM_VALUES("total costs"),
    SETUP_PARAM_VALUES("total costs")
  )
)

21.label: total cash inflows
21.formula: =ARRAYFORMULA(CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("in loans received") + CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("out loan repayments received") +CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("revenue"))

22.label: cash outflows before debt service
22.formula:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("land expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("setup expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("construction expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("infra expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("direct operating expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("other operating expenses") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("company tax") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("out loans disbursements")
)

23.label: cash before debt service
23.formula: =ARRAYFORMULA(CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("cash opening") + CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("total cash inflows") - CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("cash outflows before debt service"))

26.label: total cash outflows
26.formula: =ARRAYFORMULA(CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("cash outflows before debt service") + CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("in loans repayments"))

34.label: accrued interest closing
34.formula:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  SCAN(
    0, 
    CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("interest generated") - 
    CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("interest paid"),
    LAMBDA(balance, change, balance + change)
  )
)

39.label: deductions
39.formula:
=ARRAYFORMULA(
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("construction depreciation") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("setup depreciation") +
  CASH_FLOW_PARAM_VALUES("in loan interest expense")
)

budgetFormulaDefinitions.formula_1:
=LET(
  budget_year, BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
  start_month, DATE(budget_year, 1, 1),
  month_count, MAX(0, MIN(12, (YEAR(TODAY()) - budget_year) * 12 + MONTH(TODAY()) - 1)),
  IF(
    month_count = 0,
    0,
    LET(
      months, R_MONTHS,
      draws, OUT_LOAN_PARAM_VALUES_BY_LOAN("Totals", "total out loans disbursements"),
      actual, IFNA(
        SUM(
          FILTER(
            draws,
            IFERROR(YEAR(months) = budget_year, FALSE),
            months < MONTH_START(TODAY())
          )
        ),
        0
      ),
      BUDGET_TIMELINE_LINK(
        S_OUT_LOANS,
        198423991,
        "param",
        "total out loans disbursements",
        start_month,
        month_count,
        actual
      )
    )
  )
)

budgetFormulaDefinitions.formula_4:
=LET(
  available_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("available budget"),
  IF(
    available_budget = "",
    "",
    LET(
      past_payments, BUDGET_VALUE("past expenses"),
      planned_budget, BUDGET_VALUE("required budget"),
      IFS(
        past_payments > available_budget,
        "Already Over Budget",
        planned_budget > available_budget,
        "Projected Over Budget",
        available_budget = 0,
        "No Budget",
        TRUE,
        "Within Budget"
      )
    )
  )
)
budgetFormulaDefinitions.formula_5:
=LET(
  budget_year, BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
  year_start, DATE(budget_year, 1, 1),
  next_year_start, DATE(budget_year + 1, 1, 1),
  current_month, MONTH_START(TODAY()),
  past_months, IF(
    current_month <= year_start,
    0,
    DATEDIF(year_start, MIN(current_month, next_year_start), "M")
  ),
  TIMELINE_CATEGORY_SUM(
    S_SETUP_EXP_A,
    BUDGET_VALUE("budget line"),
    year_start,
    past_months
  )
)
